title.en: An Act to Change the Name of the Sara High School to Victorino Salcedo High School
title.orig: An Act to Change the Name of the Sara High School to Victorino Salcedo High School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1949/ra_375_1949.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: In recognition of the meritorious services tendered by Victorino Salcedo to the municipality of Sara, Province of Iloilo, the name of Sara High School hereby changed to Victorino Salcedo High School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 14, 1949.
